jurisdictions_with_solid_material: Ontario provincial (budget cycle, Public Accounts, OFINA, FAO, education tax rates)
Large cities: Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, Brampton, London
Federal / Statistics Canada CPI (monthly releases + Reference Paper methodology)
confirmation.notes: CPI layer opened at user request. Added Statistics Canada Consumer Price Index monthly releases (national + provincial) and the Canadian CPI Reference Paper as upstream data/methodology sources. Ontario Budget and Fall Economic Outlook explicitly source CPI data from Statistics Canada and publish Ontario CPI Inflation as a core planning assumption (tables list historical + projected series; footnotes cite 'Sources: Statistics Canada and Ontario Ministry of Finance'). Municipal budgets reference inflation narratively but do not create formal structural edges beyond general cost pressure discussion. Edges use 'uses_data_from' (for the observed CPI series) and 'methodology_depends_on' (for the Reference Paper). No forced municipal CPI nodes; coverage remains data-driven.

proposed_reports.title: Ontario Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual provincial budget document presenting the government's economic outlook, fiscal plan, revenue and expense projections, borrowing program, and policy measures. Includes the multi-year path to balance, net debt-to-GDP projections, and detailed fiscal tables. Most recent: 2026 Ontario Budget: A Plan to Protect Ontario (tabled March 2026). Supplemented intra-year by First Quarter Finances and other quarterly updates.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: Annual (typically spring); supplemented by Fall Economic Outlook and Fiscal Review and quarterly finances updates

proposed_reports.title: Ontario Economic Outlook and Fiscal Review (Fall Statement)
proposed_reports.description: Mid-year update to the economic and fiscal outlook, revising GDP, revenue, expense and deficit projections relative to the spring Budget. Contains updated medium-term fiscal plan and economic assumptions. Example: 2025 Ontario Economic Outlook and Fiscal Review.

proposed_reports.title: Public Accounts of Ontario
proposed_reports.publisher: Treasury Board Secretariat / Ontario Ministry of Finance (audited by Auditor General of Ontario)
proposed_reports.description: Annual audited consolidated financial statements of the Province of Ontario for the fiscal year ended 31 March, including the Annual Report, Consolidated Financial Statements, Ministry Statements and Schedules, and Detailed Schedules of Payments. Prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards and compared against the Budget plan.

proposed_reports.title: Ontario Financing Authority
proposed_reports.publisher: Ontario Financing Authority (agency of the Province of Ontario)
proposed_reports.description: Crown agency that conducts borrowing, investment and financial risk management for the Province, manages the provincial debt, and executes the long-term public borrowing program set out in the Ontario Budget. Publishes annual reports, financial statements, borrowing program status, and investor presentations. Directly implements the funding requirements and debt-management strategy of the Budget.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: Continuous operational reporting; Annual Report and financial statements yearly

proposed_reports.title: Financial Accountability Office of Ontario
proposed_reports.publisher: Financial Accountability Office of Ontario (independent officer of the Legislative Assembly)
proposed_reports.description: Independent office established by the Financial Accountability Officer Act, 2013. Provides non-partisan analysis to the Legislative Assembly on the state of the Province’s finances (including the Budget), trends in the provincial and national economies, expenditure estimates, and the financial costs/benefits of public bills or proposals. Issues Budget Notes, Economic and Budget Outlook reports, and annual reports.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: Multiple reports per year; Annual Report

proposed_reports.title: City of Toronto Operating and Capital Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual tax- and rate-supported operating budget and multi-year capital budget and plan adopted by City Council (Mayor's proposed budget under City of Toronto Act). Includes property-tax levy requirements, service-area allocations, and 10-year capital plan. Most recent: 2026 Operating Budget ($18.9 billion) and 2026–2035 Capital Budget and Plan ($63.1 billion).

proposed_reports.title: City of Toronto Consolidated Financial Statements / Annual Financial Report
proposed_reports.publisher: City of Toronto (Finance & Treasury; audited by external auditor)
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements (including sinking funds and trust funds) prepared in accordance with Canadian public sector accounting standards (PSAB). Accompanied by the Annual Financial Report providing narrative and statistical context. Most recent complete: 2024 statements approved 2025; 2025 draft statements available 2026.

proposed_reports.title: City of Toronto Tax Levy By-law
proposed_reports.description: Annual by-law enacted under the City of Toronto Act setting the municipal tax ratios, general local municipal levy, additional rates for budgetary increase and City Building Fund, and resulting tax rates by property class. Generates the property-tax revenue authorized by the adopted budget. Example: By-law 133-2026 (Tax Levy By-law for 2026).

proposed_reports.title: City of Toronto Long-Term Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Multi-year framework for longer-term financial decision-making, strategies and key actions to support integrated, strategic budgeting. Updated Long-Term Financial Plan adopted September 2023; subsequent status updates appear in annual budget processes and Annual Financial Reports. Provides the roadmap that informs the annual Operating and Capital Budgets.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: Periodic major updates (most recent 2023) with annual status reporting

proposed_reports.title: City of Ottawa Operating and Capital Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual tax- and rate-supported operating budget and capital budget adopted by Council under the Municipal Act. Must be balanced. Includes property-tax levy, transit levy, water/sewer rates, and multi-year capital authority. Example: 2025 Adopted Budget; 2026 draft presented late 2025.

proposed_reports.title: City of Ottawa Consolidated Financial Statements / Annual Report
proposed_reports.publisher: City of Ottawa (Finance and Corporate Services; audited by external auditor)
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with Canadian public sector accounting standards (PSAB) as required by the Municipal Act, accompanied by the Annual Report containing financial statement discussion and analysis and statistical schedules. Most recent: 2024 Annual Report (released 2025); 2025 statements presented 2026.

proposed_reports.title: City of Ottawa Tax Policy and Annual Tax Rate Bylaws
proposed_reports.description: Council-approved tax ratios by property class and subclass, together with the annual bylaws that establish municipal tax rates based on the adopted budget levy requirement and MPAC assessment. Equivalent function to Toronto’s Tax Levy By-law. Includes small-business subclass, multi-residential ratio path, and capping/clawback parameters.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: Annual (ratios and rates set each year)

proposed_reports.title: Ontario Education Tax Rates (O. Reg. 400/98 as amended)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Finance (Minister of Finance)
proposed_reports.description: Annual regulation under the Education Act prescribing the tax rates for school purposes that every municipality must levy and collect on rateable property. Rates are set by the Minister of Finance (most recent update O. Reg. 297/25 for 2026). Municipalities apply these rates to MPAC assessments alongside their own municipal rates. Education portion typically ~20-25% of a residential tax bill.

proposed_reports.title: City of Toronto Municipal Land Transfer Tax (MLTT) and Municipal Non-Resident Speculation Tax
proposed_reports.description: Municipal Land Transfer Tax levied on property conveyances in Toronto (Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 760) plus the Municipal Non-Resident Speculation Tax (10% on eligible foreign buyers, effective 2025). Graduated rate structure for high-value residential properties updated 2026. Significant own-source revenue tool referenced in the Long-Term Financial Plan and annual budgets.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: Rates and structure updated by bylaw as needed; ongoing administration

proposed_reports.title: City of Mississauga Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating and capital budget adopted by Council. Includes City portion of property tax levy (Region of Peel and education are separate). Most recent: 2026 Budget adopted January 2026.

proposed_reports.title: City of Mississauga Consolidated Financial Statements / Financial and Sustainability Report
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with Public Sector Accounting Board standards as required by the Municipal Act, 2001, accompanied by the Financial and Sustainability Report.

proposed_reports.title: City of Mississauga Tax Ratios and Rates By-law
proposed_reports.description: Annual by-law establishing tax ratios and levies for the year (e.g. By-law 0061-2026). Property tax calculated as MPAC assessment × combined City + Region of Peel + education rates.

proposed_reports.title: City of Hamilton Tax & Rate Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual tax-supported operating and capital budget plus rate-supported (water) budget. Adopted under Municipal Act / Strong Mayor powers. Includes Property Tax Levy By-law.

proposed_reports.title: City of Hamilton Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements and statistical information prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards.

proposed_reports.title: City of Hamilton Tax Ratios and Tax Levy By-laws
proposed_reports.description: Annual by-laws establishing tax ratios (s. 308 Municipal Act) and setting/levying the rates of taxation based on the budget levy requirement and the last returned MPAC assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: City of Brampton Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating and capital budget. City portion of property tax; Region of Peel and education collected on behalf of others. 2026 Budget featured 0% increase on City portion.

proposed_reports.title: City of Brampton Consolidated Financial Statements / Financial Report
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards / PSAB, published in the annual Financial Report.

proposed_reports.title: City of Brampton Tax Ratios By-law
proposed_reports.description: Annual by-law establishing tax ratios for lower-tier and upper-tier purposes (authority often delegated by Region of Peel). Property tax = MPAC assessment × combined rates.

proposed_reports.title: City of London Multi-Year Budget
proposed_reports.description: Multi-year (currently 2024–2027) property-tax and rate-supported budget with annual updates. Sets the tax levy requirement used to calculate rates.

proposed_reports.title: City of London Consolidated Financial Statements / Financial Report
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Public Sector Accounting Standards, published in the annual Financial Report.

proposed_reports.title: City of London Tax Rates and Codes
proposed_reports.description: Annual tax rates and codes set by Council after budget adoption. Calculated from the tax levy requirement and MPAC assessments; education rates applied as prescribed by the Province.

proposed_reports.title: City of Guelph Multi-Year Budget / Confirmed Budget
proposed_reports.description: Multi-year budget (e.g. 2024–2027) with annual confirmed updates. Sets the City tax levy requirement used for rate calculation. Includes local boards and shared services and hospital levy components.

proposed_reports.title: City of Guelph Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards / Municipal Act requirements. Clean (unqualified) audit opinions routinely received.

proposed_reports.title: City of Guelph Property Tax Rates
proposed_reports.description: Published annual tax rates by property class combining City levy, hospital levy (where applicable), and provincial education rates applied to MPAC assessment.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kingston Operating and Capital Budgets
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating and capital budgets proposed under Strong Mayor powers and adopted by Council. Includes tax levy requirement.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kingston Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kingston Tax Levy By-law
proposed_reports.description: Annual by-law setting and levying tax rates based on the adopted budget and the returned assessment roll. Includes schedules for municipal general, area rates, and education.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Caledon Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating and capital budget. Includes property tax increase plus dedicated infrastructure levy. Lower-tier municipality within Region of Peel.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Caledon Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards as required by the Municipal Act.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Caledon Tax Rates / Levy
proposed_reports.description: Annual tax rates set by Council after budget adoption. Combined with Region of Peel and education rates on MPAC assessment. Includes infrastructure levy component.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Cobourg Capital and Operating Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual capital and operating budget setting the municipal levy. Recent budgets have emphasized reserve-funded capital and modest levy increases after assessment growth.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Cobourg Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Audited financial statements prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards / Municipal Act requirements.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Cobourg Tax Rates
proposed_reports.description: Published tax rates and illustrative bill breakdown showing Town, County, and education portions calculated on MPAC current-value assessment.

proposed_reports.title: Statistics Canada Consumer Price Index (CPI) – Monthly Releases
proposed_reports.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index releases (not seasonally adjusted and seasonally adjusted series). Covers All-items CPI and major components for Canada, provinces (including Ontario), and selected cities. Primary official source of observed inflation used by governments for economic outlooks and fiscal planning. Base period currently 2002=100. Released mid-month for the prior month.

proposed_reports.title: The Canadian Consumer Price Index Reference Paper
proposed_reports.description: Authoritative methodology document explaining the conceptual, structural and methodological basis of the Canadian CPI: scope, classifications, sample strategy, price collection, index calculation, quality adjustment, basket weights and updates, reliability, and history. Updated periodically (2023 edition is the current comprehensive reference).

dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources: Statistics Canada and Ontario Ministry of Finance. ... Ontario’s CPI inflation rose by an average of 1.9 per cent in 2025... For planning purposes, the Ontario Ministry of Finance is projecting Ontario CPI inflation to be 2.1 per cent in 2026...

dependencies.basis: Fall Economic Outlook / Fiscal Review tables and charts publish Ontario CPI Inflation series and cite Statistics Canada as the data source for observed inflation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources: Statistics Canada and Ontario Ministry of Finance. ... Ontario Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation was 1.7 per cent (year-over-year) in August 2025. ... Source: Statistics Canada.

dependencies.basis: The monthly CPI releases are produced according to the concepts, classifications, sampling, price collection, index calculation and basket-update methods documented in the Canadian CPI Reference Paper.
dependencies.evidence_quote: For further information on the concepts and use of the CPI, see The Canadian Consumer Price Index Reference Paper (Catalogue number 62-553-X).

dependencies.basis: While the Budget cites the published CPI series, the underlying methodology that defines what the series measures is the Reference Paper; the Budget relies on the official definition of CPI inflation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources: Statistics Canada and Ontario Ministry of Finance.
